question: **Select the MISSPELT word.**
solution:
The correct answer is "**Farnish**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• '**Farnish**' seems to be a misspelling, and it might possibly be meant to be 'Furnish'. 
 
• '**Furnish**' means to supply furniture or necessary equipment. (सुसज्जित)
 
 
• **Example:** *They decided to furnish their new house with antique furniture.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Option 2**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let’s have a look at the correct spelling and meaning of the remaining options.
 
• '**Attain**' means to achieve or accomplish. (प्राप्त करना)
 
• '**Allergy**' means an abnormal reaction of the body to a previously encountered allergen. (एलर्जी) 
 
• '**Fabulous**' means almost impossible to believe or incredibly great. (अविश्वसनीय)
